# Canvy

> Canvy is a free, hand-drawn diagram editor that runs entirely in the browser, in Thai and English. No account and no server: a diagram lives in the person's browser or inside its link. An AI can make a diagram for someone by writing a command link: the diagram is plain text in the URL, and opening the link builds it as an editable diagram.

- Editor: https://kimookpong.github.io/canvy/app/
- Home: https://kimookpong.github.io/canvy/
- Source: https://github.com/kimookpong/canvy

## Command links

```
https://kimookpong.github.io/canvy/app/#c=<diagram>&title=<title>&dir=<LR|TB>&style=<style>
```

- `c` (required): the diagram, in Canvy syntax (below) or Mermaid `flowchart` / `graph` syntax. Percent-encode it with encodeURIComponent: spaces → `%20`, `->` → `-%3E`, new line → `%0A`, `&` → `%26`, `#` → `%23`, `?` → `%3F`. Thai text must be percent-encoded too.
- `title` (optional): diagram name. Percent-encoded.
- `dir` (optional): `LR` (left to right, default) or `TB` (top to bottom). Use `TB` for org charts, approvals and long processes.
- `style` (optional): `pencil` (default), `chalk`, `marker`, `blueprint`, `ink`, `neon`.
- Read-only link: put `?view=1` before the `#`: `https://kimookpong.github.io/canvy/app/?view=1#c=...`
- Embed in a page: `?embed=1` in an `<iframe>`.

Opening a command link creates a new diagram in that browser. The person can then edit, restyle, present (each frame becomes a slide) and export it to PNG, SVG, PDF or Mermaid.

## Canvy syntax

| Write | Gives |
| --- | --- |
| `a -> b -> c` | Boxes joined by arrows |
| `a -(label)-> b` or `a -> b: label` | Label on an arrow |
| `a -- b` · `a <-> b` · `a ..> b` | Plain line · two-way arrow · dashed arrow |
| `db:Orders` `queue:Jobs` `user:Customer` `note:Text` `cloud:CDN` `doc:Report` `io:Input` `hex:Step` `start:Begin` `end:Done` `decision:OK?` `card:Title` | Pick a shape by prefix |
| `[(Orders)]` `(Round)` `{Decision?}` `{{Hex}}` `[/Input/]` `([Pill])` | Pick a shape with brackets |
| `## Heading` | Section title above the shapes that follow |
| `,` `;` or a new line | Start another chain |
| `\| a \| b \|` rows | A table |

The same label always means the same box, so branches are written as separate chains that repeat the label:

```
start:Order -> Check stock -> {In stock?}
{In stock?} -(yes)-> Ship -> end:Done
{In stock?} -(no)-> Tell customer
```

Mermaid works too:

```
flowchart TB
  A[Lamp doesn't work] --> B{Plugged in?}
  B -- No --> C[Plug in lamp]
  B -- Yes --> D[Repair lamp]
```

## Example link

Diagram `ลูกค้า -> สั่งซื้อ -> {มีของ?}, {มีของ?} -(มี)-> จัดส่ง, {มีของ?} -(ไม่มี)-> แจ้งลูกค้า`, top to bottom, titled ขั้นตอนสั่งซื้อ:

https://kimookpong.github.io/canvy/app/#c=%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%84%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%B2%20-%3E%20%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B1%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B7%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD%20-%3E%20%7B%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%87%3F%7D%2C%20%7B%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%87%3F%7D%20-(%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B5)-%3E%20%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%87%2C%20%7B%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%87%3F%7D%20-(%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%A1%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B5)-%3E%20%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%88%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%84%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%B2&title=%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%B1%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B1%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B7%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD&dir=TB

## Tips for good diagrams

- Keep labels short (1–4 words); put detail in arrow labels or a `note:`.
- One idea per chain; repeat a label to branch or join.
- Use `{…?}` for decisions and label both ways out (`-(yes)->`, `-(no)->`).
- Use `db:` for stores, `user:` for people, `queue:` for queues, `start:`/`end:` for the ends of a process.
- About 3–25 boxes reads well. Split bigger systems with `## Heading` sections.

## Other ways in

- Local MCP server for Claude Desktop and Claude Code: https://github.com/kimookpong/canvy/tree/main/mcp
- In the editor: type the same syntax in the command bar, paste Mermaid, open `.excalidraw` files, or turn a photo of a diagram into an editable one (Photo to diagram).
